title: [Bug Fix] #304: [SOA] Re-resolve new sender to created contact after 'I have added the contact'
summary: Sales Order Agent now correctly re-resolves sender information to the newly created contact after a user adds a contact in the chat, allowing the agent to proceed instead of reporting the customer cannot be found.
key_points: Rewrote intervention instruction label to explicitly command re-navigation to contact list
Agent searches for newly created contact before falling back to customer list
Fixes agent getting stuck when email arrives from unrecognized sender and user creates contact
Root cause was stale customer-list context preventing proper contact lookup after creation
Contact without linked customer continues to be supported via contact number filter
